name: nonApi_setEmailBlocked
description: The member's 'no email from Harrier Central at all' switch (E19.F4). Set from the email-preferences page reached by the signed link in every list email; it is the member's unsubscribe and is honoured above every preference and every admin override (nonApi_runEmailContext reasonCode 7). Blocking (@blocked = 1) also switches every kennel email setting (HasherKennelMap.KennelEmailAlertPreference ⇒ 2) and every per-run 'on' override (HasherEventMap.EventEmailAlertPreference 1 ⇒ 2) off, so nothing is left that could re-enable them by accident; unblocking only clears the flag. HC.Hasher.updatedAt is not touched (the Hasher triggers ignore these columns) — but the HKM/HEM rows it flips ARE restamped by their triggers and re-sync, which is wanted: the app shows those settings. One LOG.GeneralLog row (LogSource 'EmailStatus') per call. Idempotent. Called by the EmailPreferences API endpoint after it has verified the signed token; no device auth. @hasherId is required (NULL ⇒ THROW ⇒ Success 0 envelope, logged).

parameters.name: hasherId
parameters.description: The member. Required (NULL ⇒ Success 0 'hasherId is required'). Default NULL.

parameters.name: blocked
parameters.description: 1 = block all email (default); anything else = lift the block.

rowsets.name: SuccessEnvelope
rowsets.description: Always exactly one row: the standard { Success, ErrorMessage } envelope, from the TRY on success or the CATCH on failure.

columns.name: Success
columns.description: 1 on success, 0 when the CATCH block ran.

columns.name: ErrorMessage
columns.description: NULL on success; ERROR_MESSAGE() from the CATCH block on failure.

sideEffects: UPDATE HC.Hasher SET EmailBlocked = 1/0, EmailBlockedAt = now/NULL WHERE id = @hasherId AND the flag actually changes. updatedAt untouched; no Hasher re-sync.

@blocked = 1: UPDATE HC.HasherKennelMap SET KennelEmailAlertPreference = 2 for the hasher's live rows not already 2 — trgUpdateModifiedOnDateForHasherKennelMap restamps updatedAt on those rows (they re-sync).

@blocked = 1: UPDATE HC.HasherEventMap SET EventEmailAlertPreference = 2 WHERE UserId = @hasherId AND EventEmailAlertPreference = 1 — trgUpdateModifiedOnDateForHasherEventMap restamps updatedAt on those rows (they re-sync).
Inserts one LOG.GeneralLog row (LogSource 'EmailStatus', 'All emails blocked by member' / 'Email block lifted'). All inside one transaction.
On any runtime error: rolls back, inserts one HC.ErrorLog row (HcVersion '<api>', userId = @hasherId), returns the envelope with Success 0.

codeSmells.issue: Header says 'Never touches updatedAt' but the HKM/HEM writes do restamp it
codeSmells.detail: Lines 34–37 update HC.HasherKennelMap and HC.HasherEventMap without setting updatedAt; both tables' triggers (IF NOT UPDATE(updatedAt) ⇒ stamp now) therefore restamp every row changed, and those rows re-sync. Only the HC.Hasher write (line 27) is silent. The re-sync is desirable (the app shows the preference), so this is a comment inaccuracy, not a bug.

breakingChangeRules: Never remove a column from any rowset
Never change a sentinel value meaning
Never change errorType integer codes without updating all callers
